scope: one-hour timing/stability demonstration; separate fresh201s confirmatory centring recording

engineering_gates.rss_comparison: last10min median versus first10min median after warmup; capture only

temperature: report capture-only range, plateau, measured ARM clock and throttle flags; no independent thermal certification
provenance: 300ms and hot-throughput acceptance are user decisions; duty/cadence/memory/integrity bounds are explicit engineering criteria chosen before this new capture, not previously measured passes

gate_scopes.window_clock: first processed frame captured_at +120s; consecutive half-open600s windows ending at last processed frame
gate_scopes.final_partial_window: at least60s: evaluate same per-window gates; under60s: report without a window verdict, retain all samples in whole-hot-span and whole-capture gates
gate_scopes.memory: capture-only samples after first captured frame+120s; compare median of first600s and last600s; incomplete memory windows are inconclusive
gate_scopes.missing_evidence: missing/invalid measurements prevent a pass; recording or cleanup failures are not filtered out
gate_scopes.first_use: deduplicate reconstructed sensor observation timestamp (tick_start-age) with1us tolerance; count the first tracking/stale tick for each new timestamp

evidence_completeness.rule: Missing hot telemetry coverage is inconclusive, not silently accepted; same-boot latch receipts independently cover voltage sampling gaps.
